title: Amber Creative
line: The website of a digital marketing agency in Singapore.
problem: Amber Creative is a digital marketing agency in Singapore that provides branding, web development and paid media services. Their own website needed new sections, better search engine visibility and a way for the team to update content on their own.
did: As a Software Developer Intern, I contributed to the development and maintenance of the Amber Creative website. I built responsive UI components, integrated CMS-driven content so the team could update pages themselves and implemented SEO improvements. I also worked on new features, bug fixes and optimizing the codebase.
outcome: The website now works smoothly across all devices, and the team can update its content without needing a developer.
